SELECT count(case WHEN a.signal_result='2' then 1 else null end) as 'signal', count(case WHEN a.blur_result='2' then 1 else null end) as 'blur', count(case WHEN a.contrast_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'contrast', count(case WHEN a.bright_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'bright', count(case WHEN a.dark_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'dark', count(case WHEN a.chroma_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'chroma', count(case WHEN a.mono_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'mono', count(case WHEN a.noise_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'noise', count(case WHEN a.streak_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'streak', count(case WHEN a.freeze_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'freeze', count(case WHEN a.shake_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'shake', count(case WHEN a.flash_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'flash', count(case WHEN a.scene_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'scene', count(case WHEN a.cover_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'cover', count(case WHEN a.ptz_result='2' THEN 1 ELSE null end) as 'ptz'
FROM t_diagnose_result a JOIN t_diagnose_plan b ON a.diagnose_plan_id=b.diagnose_plan_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_info c ON a.channel_id=c.monitor_id WHERE 1=1 AND b.plan_name like concat('%',#{planName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') AND c.camera_name like concat ('%',#{channelName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
